narr: Veering southerly flow ahead of an approaching cold front helped to advect a rich plume of low-level moisture across South Florida. As showers and thunderstorms associated with the front pushed through the area and stalled, this translated into heavy rainfall and flooding across east coast metro. Also, lightning strikes from one storm struck and damaged the Broward Water Treatment Plant.
ev: Several videos obtained from the media and public showed flash flooding on NE 23rd Street near Biscayne Blvd with water rising above the bottom line of several building doors, water covering the wheels of cars, and rising to knee-high level. Additional videos show street flooding near Margaret Pace Pack with an estimated two to three inches of water on the ground. Nearby rain gauges measured between 3 to 4 inches of rain in the area.
